title: What Is ABF? A Beginner's Guide to the Insulating Film in Package Substrates That Supports AI Semiconductors
excerpt: ABF is not a material inside the chip. It is a film that insulates the copper wiring in semiconductor package substrates. A beginner-friendly look at why the Ajinomoto Group's ABF supports high-performance semiconductors, covering where it is, what it does, how it is processed, and the know-how behind it.
